passages.text: Every month, Aunt Lin lets local musicians put on a free concert in her café. One Saturday, heavy rain brings mud through the open door just before the music starts. The musicians keep their instruments dry while people from next door clean up the floor. I bring old towels, and my brother moves the wet chairs away. Soon there is a dry space for everyone to sit. When the first song begins, the audience is smaller than usual but very cheerful. Aunt Lin thanks the helpers with warm drinks after the last song.

parallelText.en: Every month, Aunt Lin lets local musicians put on a free concert in her café.
parallelText.zh: 每个月，林阿姨都会让当地音乐人在她的咖啡馆举办免费音乐会。

parallelText.en: One Saturday, heavy rain brings mud through the open door just before the music starts.
parallelText.zh: 一个星期六，音乐开始前，大雨把泥水带进敞开的门。

parallelText.en: The musicians keep their instruments dry while people from next door clean up the floor.
parallelText.zh: 音乐人保护乐器不被淋湿，隔壁的人帮忙清理地面。

parallelText.en: I bring old towels, and my brother moves the wet chairs away.
parallelText.zh: 我拿来旧毛巾，弟弟把湿椅子搬开。

parallelText.en: Soon there is a dry space for everyone to sit.
parallelText.zh: 很快就有了一块干燥的地方，供大家坐下。

parallelText.en: When the first song begins, the audience is smaller than usual but very cheerful.
parallelText.zh: 第一首歌开始时，观众比平时少，但非常开心。

parallelText.en: Aunt Lin thanks the helpers with warm drinks after the last song.
parallelText.zh: 最后一首歌结束后，林阿姨用热饮感谢帮忙的人。

wordHelp.meaning: a small place serving drinks and food
an object used to make music
people watching or listening to a show

passages.text: On Sunday, my sister and I visit our neighbour for her birthday. We get a bag ready for the visit by putting a card and some fruit inside. Dad plans to drive us, but the car will not start. The neighbour's house is only three streets away, so we decide to go on foot. We follow a quiet path and stop to look at the flowers. When we arrive, our neighbour invites us to share the fruit. The short journey becomes part of her birthday story.

parallelText.en: On Sunday, my sister and I visit our neighbour for her birthday.
parallelText.zh: 星期日，我和姐姐去给邻居过生日。

parallelText.en: We get a bag ready for the visit by putting a card and some fruit inside.
parallelText.zh: 我们把卡片和一些水果装进袋子，为这次拜访准备好。

parallelText.en: Dad plans to drive us, but the car will not start.
parallelText.zh: 爸爸打算开车送我们，但汽车发动不了。

parallelText.en: The neighbour's house is only three streets away, so we decide to go on foot.
parallelText.zh: 邻居家只隔三条街，因此我们决定步行过去。

parallelText.en: We follow a quiet path and stop to look at the flowers.
parallelText.zh: 我们沿着一条安静的小路走，停下来看花。

parallelText.en: When we arrive, our neighbour invites us to share the fruit.
parallelText.zh: 到达后，邻居邀请我们一起吃水果。

parallelText.en: The short journey becomes part of her birthday story.
parallelText.zh: 这段短短的旅程成了她生日故事的一部分。
